'''Taly''' was a refugee fleeing [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] of [[Kaliska]]. Taly and the other refugees were targeted by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent [[Govin Thane]], but a group of Rebel agents helped them safely reach the transport to Kaliska.<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
